description: This file contains C++ source code implementing graph canonicalization passes for PyTorch's JIT compiler, specifically focusing on replacing certain tensor operations with more optimized or canonical forms.

classes.name: ChunkOutput
classes.description: A helper struct representing the output of a chunk operation, containing a tensor value and its offset.

methods.name: getChunkOutputs
methods.description: Extracts the outputs of a chunk node, either as individual tensor elements or as a list, returning nullopt if the structure doesn't match expectations.

methods.name: CanonicalizeOps
methods.description: Recursively traverses a graph block to replace certain tensor operations with optimized forms, such as replacing rank 0 tensor constants with scalars and unpacking chunk operations.

methods.name: CanonicalizeOps (overload)
methods.description: Applies canonicalization to the entire graph and performs dead code elimination.
